entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: An elemental god, the incarnation of Lorwyn; with Isilu it forms the plane's twin worldsouls and keeps balance between light and dark.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: An elemental god, the incarnation of Shadowmoor; it wanders the plane while Eirdu sleeps.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The faerie queen who was struck down to usher in a new age on Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: An elf and former avatar of Oona who is now steward of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor alongside Eirdu and Isilu, ruling from Glen Elendra.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: An elf of the group that defeated Oona, kept alive by a pact with Maralen and carrying a moonglove-laced dagger.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A fae planeswalker, the first avatar of Oona, whose Lorwyn self is a debauched trickster and whose Shadowmoor self is calmer.

entities.name: Morcant
entities.description: An elf tyrant, de facto leader of the elves at Lys Alana, who secretly wants to subject Lorwyn to elvish rule again.

entities.name: Brigid
entities.description: A kithkin who helped bring down Oona and now trains the city watch in Goldmeadow; once a pirate under Sygg.

entities.name: Sygg
entities.description: A merrow schoolmaster who helped take down Oona and holds a grudge about the unreturned Crescent of Morningtide.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: A flamekin dancer and pilgrim who was key in Oona's defeat and acted as the Extinguisher.

entities.name: Auntie Grub
entities.description: A boggart sage, matriarch and apothecary with a frog familiar named Smlurf, source of many boggart parables.

entities.name: Smlurf
entities.description: Auntie Grub's frog familiar.

entities.name: Trystan
entities.description: Morcant's elf poison master and horticulturist who secretly despises her.

entities.name: Doran
entities.description: A treefolk who in Shadowmoor is a voiceless, cursed wanderer afraid to cross back into the light.

entities.name: Bre of Clan Stoutarm
entities.description: A giant herder, daughter of Brion Stoutarm, who hurls elves far away.

entities.name: Brion Stoutarm
entities.description: Bre's father, whose death Bre blames on the elves.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: An elf who prefers animals to people, born to elvish supremacists.

entities.name: Ferrafor
entities.description: The last yew treefolk, awakened by a special Rising; cruel and vindictive in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: A yew treefolk whose sapling's death presumably ended the yew subspecies; Rhys was his former apprentice.

entities.name: Mass of Mysteries
entities.description: A boundless elemental born when Oona fell, representing the potential of the unknown.

entities.name: Auntie Ool
entities.description: An infamous Shadowmoor boggart known for witty, potent curses and a hut with giant frog-like legs.

entities.name: The Reaper, King No More
entities.description: A deadly scarecrow contraption, ruler of scarecrows of Shadowmoor, who has lost much of its domain.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: A deaf owlin Strixhaven student who conjures images and emotions in others' minds.

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: A goblin Strixhaven student who flits between half-finished creative projects.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: An athletic, inquisitive vampire Strixhaven student fascinated by the past.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: A studious gorgon Strixhaven student who wields paradox magic.

entities.name: Crescent of Morningtide
entities.description: A relic that Sygg's former friends never returned.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: Maralen's throne seat.

entities.name: Lys Alana
entities.description: The elf city where Morcant leads.

entities.name: Goldmeadow
entities.description: The town where Brigid trains the city watch.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university from which several students come.

events.summary: Eirdu and Isilu emerge after the downfall of Oona.
events.quote: They emerged after the downfall of Oona

events.summary: Maralen, originally an avatar of Oona, becomes steward of the plane from Glen Elendra.
events.quote: Originally an avatar of Oona, Maralen is now the steward of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor alongside Eirdu and Isilu

events.summary: Maralen grants Rhys immortality on condition that he poison her if Oona's power corrupts her.
events.quote: she granted Rhys immortality on the condition that he must poison her should any hint arise that Oona's power is corrupting her.

events.summary: Oko, Oona's first avatar, rebels and leaves the plane after he sparked.
events.quote: Oko was quick to leave the plane after he sparked and has been causing turmoil across the Multiverse ever since.

events.summary: Brigid and Sygg are part of the group that brought down Oona; Brigid once sailed as a pirate under Sygg.
events.quote: A principled member of the group responsible for Oona's downfall

events.summary: Ashling departs the Blessed Nation at the start of the Pendulum Year to reconcile her two selves and discover the fourth path.
events.quote: At the beginning of the Pendulum Year, she departed the Blessed Nation

events.summary: A secret cutting of Colfenor's sapling is saved by Rhys and awakened by a special Rising as Ferrafor, the last yew treefolk.
events.quote: Awoken by a special version of the Rising, her first moments were of death and pain.

events.summary: The Mass of Mysteries is born when Oona is struck down.
events.quote: a curious new entity was born—the Mass of Mysteries.

events.summary: The Reaper loses much of its domain over the scarecrows as the aspects merge.
events.quote: But with the planar merging of aspects, it lost much of its domain and control over the scarecrows of Shadowmoor.

relations.note: Maralen was originally an avatar of Oona.

relations.quote: Oko was the first avatar of Oona and an abysmal failure.

relations.note: Bound by a pact; she calls him her friend.
relations.quote: awaiting the day he will be forced to kill his friend.

relations.note: Morcant is de facto leader of the elves at Lys Alana.
relations.quote: High Perfect Morcant is the de facto leader of the elves at Lys Alana

relations.note: He is her poison master, though he despises her.

relations.quote: The daughter of Brion Stoutarm, Bre is a herder at heart and slow to anger.
She and her frog familiar, Smlurf, have survived from the Age of Oona until today

relations.note: Rhys, Colfenor's former apprentice, saved the cutting from which Ferrafor grew.
relations.quote: saved by Colfenor's former apprentice, Rhys

relations.note: Brigid remembers her time as a pirate under Sygg.
relations.quote: she wistfully remembers her time as a pirate under Sygg.

relations.note: Ashling was a key figure in Oona's defeat.
relations.quote: She was a key figure in the defeat of Oona

relations.note: Twin gods that keep balance between light and darkness.
relations.quote: They are stewards of the plane's light and darkness, keeping balance between the two.
